item.text:
This pass confirmed the race-mode behavior of the harness change and finalized the report.

**Race-mode matrix**

- Audited tree, root package under `-race` (race-aware timeouts, 8 MB cross-node payload case): **13 PASS, 1 FAIL** — the failure is exactly the Finding-1 reproduction (`TestAuditNodeUserReadIndexOneTickTimeout`), same as without `-race`.
- Fixed copy (`audit/diag-fixes/`) under `-race`: whole audit suite green (`internal/raft`, `raftpb`, root).

That closes the loop on the harness change: the F1 result is stable across race and non-race runs, and the minimal fixes hold under the race detector too.

**Final state of the audit**

Three findings, each reproduced on the unmodified source and each resolved by a minimal patch with no regressions:

- F1 — `(*nodeUser).ReadIndex` in [nodehost.go](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_20-19-30-dragonboat_raft-baseline/work/nodehost.go:2063) misses the engine wakeup: ~one RTT added latency; one-RTT timeouts deterministically fail, two-RTT succeed, while `NodeHost.ReadIndex` completes.
- F2 — `handleCandidateReadIndex` in [raft.go](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_20-19-30-dragonboat_raft-baseline/work/internal/raft/raft.go:1998) records a dropped ReadIndex twice; visible via `Peer.GetUpdate`, idempotent downstream.
- F3 — `pb.Update.HasUpdate` in [raftpb/raft.go](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_20-19-30-dragonboat_raft-baseline/work/raftpb/raft.go:112) ignores `DroppedReadIndexes`, contradicting `Peer.HasUpdate`.

Negative-result coverage includes the protocol fuzz, in-memory log model, vote-survives-restart, colfer entry encoding, follower/observer reads, leader transfer, witness election after leader loss, 1–32 MB payloads, dropped-read-index idempotence, stop/restart endurance with snapshots, single-node and cross-node linearizability, and multi-cluster isolation — plus one recorded extreme-configuration observation (32 MB entries with a 10 ms RTT under `-race` trigger election churn).

[report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_20-19-30-dragonboat_raft-baseline/work/report.md) (578 lines) is the complete handoff; all audit files are gofmt/vet-clean and the implementation remains byte-identical to `../source`.
